title: AudioReactiveEngine outside React, plus an e2e-only test hook
why: Status: DONE (cursor, 02 Oct 13:45 PKT); v2 keeps it as built. useAudioLevels called setState 30 times a second in the top-level hook, so the whole dashboard re-rendered for the entire voice session (audit 4.2), and fftSize 64 wasted most bars. The orb needs real bands from the agent track and from the local mic, and e2e runs need a hook because the mock bridge always answers /livekit/token with 503. v2 alignment lives in later tasks: X-75 adds the coarse 30 Hz sampling while the orb is idle and moves loop/draw stats to the orb renderer; X-97 wires the setVoiceState/setVoiceInputs overrides into the state derivation; X-109 adds referenceFrame() (spec v2 §8.4, §8.11).
steps: audioEngine.ts singleton. Bind the agent RemoteAudioTrack, and the local mic LocalAudioTrack with cloneTrack:true while the mic publishes, each through livekit createAudioAnalyser (fftSize 1024, smoothingTimeConstant 0.6, minDecibels -90, maxDecibels -22). In livekit-client 2.22 every call creates a new AudioContext: keep one analyser per bound track, call its cleanup() on every unbind (track unsubscribed, reconnect, mic off, unmount), and call resume() on each live analyser.context from the Enable audio click (with room.startAudio()) and from every Mic toggle gesture.

Per frame: getFloatTimeDomainData → RMS → dBFS = 20·log10(rms) → level = clamp((dBFS + 56) / 40). calculateVolume() is the RMS of the byte frequency bins (0..1), not dBFS: do not use it for the level. 24 log-spaced bands 80 Hz–5 kHz from getByteFrequencyData, a 128-sample waveform and an onset flag. Attack 30 ms, release 120 ms. Keep a timestamped ring of band snapshots so the renderer reads them by age in milliseconds. Expose subscribe/read; never call setState per frame.

Coarse React state only: agentState (lk.agent.state), isSpeaking (state speaking, or agent RMS above the threshold for ≥ 120 ms) and isUserSpeaking from a local VAD (mic dBFS above −45 for 100 ms, released after 400 ms below −50); ActiveSpeakersChanged including the local identity confirms it and alone enters listening when the mic analyser is unavailable. Remove setAgentLevel and setVizFrame, and stop passing agentLevel, vizFrame and spectralDataRef through the tree. Pause reading on document.hidden. Keep the hidden <audio> element.

E2E hook, compiled only into e2e builds: vite.config.ts `define: { __E2E_HOOKS__: JSON.stringify(process.env.VITE_E2E_HOOKS === '1') }`; declare it in src/vite-env.d.ts; in main.tsx `if (__E2E_HOOKS__) void import('./features/voice/e2eHooks').then(m => m.install())`; playwright.config.ts webServer[1].env gets VITE_E2E_HOOKS: '1'. Specs fail fast with 'e2e hook missing: rebuild with VITE_E2E_HOOKS=1'.

e2eHooks.ts installs window.__jarvisTest: setVoiceState(state / null) and setVoiceInputs({room, agentAbsent, audioBlocked, activity, micOn, listening}); feedAgent(level, bands[24]) / feedAgent('speech') / feedAgent(null) and the same feedUser; bindAgentStream(MediaStream) runs the real createAudioAnalyser path on a synthetic track; stats() returns {loop, draws, roomWrites, commits}, where commits counts DashboardInner renders through an e2e-only useEffect without deps.

audio-engine.spec.ts (launch args --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required): two OscillatorNodes (440 Hz and 1.2 kHz, −20 dBFS together) bound with bindAgentStream read −20 ± 3 dBFS and their bands are the two largest; unbinding closes that AudioContext; setVoiceState('speaking') + feedAgent('speech') for 5 s adds at most 10 DashboardInner commits.

The real analyser path works without LiveKit: a −20 dBFS oscillator stream reads −20 ± 3 dBFS, the right bands light up, and cleanup() closes the context on unbind.
